name: shell-topbar-flow
description: Top navigation + a vertical stack of bands + rich footer. The bar and the footer span the screen; the bands sit in the measured content column (theme width, page gutter). The visitor reads by scrolling.
provenPattern: Shell matrix — chrome × body: 5 chromes × 4 bodies = 20, four eliminated (with no chrome a grid has no way out, a dense surface has no interaction, a split refutes itself) → 16 cells.

knowledge.purpose: The frame of a page read by scrolling down: navigation is secondary, the bands tell the story in order
antiPatterns: Turning the main region into a widget grid — that is the shell-topbar-grid cell
Adding a persistent left rail — a stack of bands is not read alongside a rail; that is the composite shell
More than two conversion bands — emphasis scatters

mobileCollapse: The top bar collapses into a drawer; links are listed in one column. Bands are already single-column; order is kept.

placeholders.{{FOOTER}}: footer copyright line — PLAIN TEXT, one line. The ONLY place the copyright appears: the `footer` band carries link columns and never a copyright. A rich footer (columns, social) does not go here — place the `footer` pattern as the last band
placeholders.{{MAIN}}: main slot — the bands and weaves of the page sit here, in reading order
